ClassificationProvenance: User-supplied 117-rule proposal, matched against source inventory and legacy help; docs/assessment/proposed-rule-risk-policy.json SHA256 4baa1eeaf4f133b0a936d3322f2ae54d09405eb0c263cce0ddf19e7ffdec4123. Runtime applicability and migrated permission controls retain their implemented semantics.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Fewer than two administrators creates continuity and recovery risk rather than an immediate security exposure.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Account for centralized operations and break-glass access.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. More than four project administrators increases privileged-access exposure, but a fixed count is not evidence of inappropriate access.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Risk depends on identity quality, PIM, and project scale; configure threshold.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Nesting all Project Valid Users into another group may grant unintended permissions to everyone in a project.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Verify destination group privileges and membership before escalating.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Inactive subscription may interrupt services, a business-availability risk not necessarily security.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Check grace periods and service-critical impact; not a security-score input.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Enterprise billing preference is organizational administration, not security.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Mark N/A absent an explicit billing policy.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Assignment billing model is a commercial choice, not a security control.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Mark N/A unless enterprise billing standard requires it.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Organization description supports governance and discovery.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: No security impact.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Hard-coded Amsterdam/CET time zone is region-specific, not a universal security requirement.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: N/A outside the required local organization time zone.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. European geography matters only when an explicit residency requirement applies.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Conditional compliance policy; not universally required.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Missing organization owner creates accountability and incident-response continuity gaps.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Operational governance; can be High if ownership is abandoned.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Anonymous pipeline badge exposure reveals limited operational metadata.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Overlap with StatusBadgesPrivate at project level.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Unrestricted queue-time variable overrides can alter privileged pipeline execution.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Risk depends on who can queue runs and which variables are settable.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Unscoped non-release pipeline tokens increase cross-project access if token permissions are broad.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Documentation appears to describe release setting; verify source property independently.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Release pipeline job token privileges should be restricted to necessary projects.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Potential duplicate/misdocumented check with non-release version; verify implementation.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Unrestricted repository access from YAML jobs can enable unauthorized repository reads.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Check referenced repository token scopes and legitimate cross-repo workflows.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Allowing classic build pipelines is not an exploitable security weakness itself.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Accept controlled classic definitions; modernization opportunity.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Allowing classic release pipelines is a process/modernization choice.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Existing approval gates can be secure; migration not always required.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Weak fork protection may run attacker-controlled code in trusted pipeline contexts.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Relevant only if forks and privileged builds are enabled.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Allowing fork builds is not inherently unsafe when secrets and token scopes are isolated.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Treat as defense in depth, not unconditional prohibition.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Unsanitized shell arguments may enable command injection in affected tasks.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Confirm attacker-controlled input reaches a command execution sink.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Selectable pipeline stages are not intrinsically insecure with protected deploy permissions.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Escalate only on demonstrated bypass of required stages.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Globally disabling built-in task variables is not a generally necessary secure default.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Verify feature intent and impact; may be contrary to team needs.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Marketplace task restrictions mitigate supplier risk but approved extensions can be legitimate.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Use allowlists, publisher trust and pinning as alternatives.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Legacy Node 6 execution introduces unsupported-runtime and dependency risks.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: N/A when no legacy tasks are in use.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Fork-origin job tokens can access too much if authorization scope is unbounded.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Only relevant to fork pipelines with meaningful token rights.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Fork-origin pipeline code must not receive usable organization secrets.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Conditional on running fork builds with accessible secrets.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Implicit YAML CI trigger is a workflow choice; run security depends on permissions and secrets.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Not a universal security requirement.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Audit-only setting improves visibility but does not enforce variable restrictions.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Complementary to enforceSettableVar, not equivalent.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Task lockdown reduces exposure to untrusted tasks but depends on task allowlisting.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Assess other marketplace governance controls.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Unrestricted pipeline policy management can let untrusted users weaken protection.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Verify effective user rights; policy may already be restricted elsewhere.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Requiring PR comments is a workflow convention, not evidence of secure peer review.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: May overlap with the next two comment-scope settings.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Comments required for non-team members add change context, not access isolation.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Applicability depends on external contribution patterns.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Comments required for selected contributor types improve change context.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Check whether these three comment modes are mutually exclusive.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Argument sanitization audit helps diagnostics, but lack of auditing is not direct injection.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Do not confuse auditing with prevention.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Disabling SSH authentication is not a universal best practice; secure SSH keys are legitimate.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Only enforce if corporate policy bans SSH or specific keys cannot be controlled.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Disallowing access-token requests is a governance preference, not demonstrated privilege escalation.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Review actual token issuance and admin approval flow.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Delegated invitations can grow the user population, but admin delegation may be intentional.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Risk depends on who can invite and subsequent permissions.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Feedback collection is privacy/telemetry preference, not a significant security vulnerability.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Apply privacy requirements rather than vulnerability scoring.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Lack of enforced conditional access can weaken interactive sign-in policy coverage.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Verify tenant CA policy, licensing and how authentication actually occurs.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Permitting OAuth apps can increase third-party integration exposure, but OAuth is legitimate.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Evaluate app consent and restrictions; disabling is not universal.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Lack of audit event logging reduces detection, investigation and accountability.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Check any alternative organizational audit collection and retention.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Disabling external-package protection can increase dependency compromise risk.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Verify setting semantics and whether external artifact feeds are used.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Allowing anonymous access can expose projects that should be private.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Critical if sensitive project content is actually public; N/A for open-source organizations.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Guest-user access is legitimate for partners; blanket disallowance is not universally required.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: High if ungoverned guests obtain excessive rights; otherwise policy-dependent.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. YAML pipelines improve source-controlled change management but classic definitions are not automatically insecure.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Accept equivalent approval/change-control safeguards.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Inherited pipeline permissions are not intrinsically unsafe; excessive EFFECTIVE access is the real risk.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Escalate only if inheritance permits unauthorized pipeline edits, runs or secret access.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Unprotected secrets in build variables can be exposed to pipeline authors, execution or logs.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Confirm actual secret content, variable masking and who can read/run the pipeline.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Giving all valid project users explicit pipeline permissions can permit unintended modifications or executions.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Inspect permission bits, not group presence alone.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Missing environment checks weakens protection against unintended production deployment.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Other protective gates may mitigate; determine whether environment is production.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Human approval protects production changes, but is not universally required for mature automated controls.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Accept risk-approved automated verification and separation of duties.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Missing environment description reduces discoverability, not security.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Do not treat as security risk.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Without branch restrictions an environment may be reachable from untrusted or unintended branches.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Apply only to truly privileged production environments; evaluate other controls.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Environment ACL inheritance is a configuration model, not proof of privilege leakage.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Assess who can administer/use production environments.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Granting all project users permissions to an environment may expose privileged deployment capabilities.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Check effective roles and whether environment is sensitive.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Floating hosted-agent image versions can introduce compatibility changes, mainly a reproducibility issue.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Version pinning may also cause support/security staleness; do not equate latest with safest.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Missing step display names affect troubleshooting and readability, not security.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Engineering hygiene only.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Missing production approval increases unauthorized or accidental release risk.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Apply to production release stages; account for equivalent independent gates.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Self-approval undermines separation of duties in production deployment.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: High for protected production; lower if alternate independent controls enforce review.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Release-pipeline ACL inheritance alone does not prove excessive permissions.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Assess effective edit/run/manage rights on sensitive releases.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Plaintext release variables can disclose credentials in pipeline configuration or logs.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Confirm secret is real and exposed, not a generic nonsecret variable.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Granting all project users release-definition permissions can allow unintended executions or edits.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Inspect actual permission assignments and reachability.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Unrestricted queue-time overrides may redirect tasks or alter security-critical deployment behavior.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Escalate only when attacker can queue runs with privileged credentials.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. A broad pipeline job token may cross project boundaries after pipeline compromise.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Assess cross-project requirements and token effective rights.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Release job authorization scope can expose other projects if token and permissions allow it.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Verify release setting semantics and shared-platform exceptions.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. YAML job token not limited to project expands potential blast radius.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Risk depends on job token permissions and cross-project access.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Requiring member review for fork builds reduces untrusted-code execution but has alternative protections.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Only relevant if fork PR workflows are allowed.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Making secrets available to fork PR pipelines creates a direct pathway to exfiltration by untrusted code.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Only relevant when fork builds and secrets can actually interact.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Untrusted shell-task arguments may become command injection when inserted into vulnerable commands.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Severity depends on attacker control and task implementation.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Anonymous status badges disclose limited pipeline metadata rather than credentials or source code.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Elevate only for specifically sensitive workflow names/timing.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Public project visibility may disclose nonpublic code, work items and pipeline metadata.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Critical only if confidential assets actually exposed; intentional open-source is N/A.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Project-wide pipeline rights for all valid users can grant inappropriate execution or management.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Custom ACL entries can be protective; inspect Allow/Deny direction.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Project-wide service connection ACL grants can expose external identities and privileged deployments.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Prioritize Use/Manage/Administrator permissions, not harmless read rights.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Project-wide repository ACL grants can broaden source-code or write access.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Read access can be intended; emphasize write/manage permissions.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Project-wide environment rights for all valid users can expose sensitive deployment operations.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Check ACL permission bits; customized deny is not necessarily risky.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Project-wide release rights for all valid users could enable unauthorized deployment changes.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Inspect actual capabilities, not merely custom ACL presence.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Project-wide variable group ACL grants can expose or permit use of secrets.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Separate read/view from secret extraction/use.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. No branch policy may weaken controls over important branches.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Overlap with BranchPolicyIsEnabled; assess actual protected branch.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Disabled branch policies can allow bypass of required review and validation.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Assess target branch and other branch protections; overlap with policy presence.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Missing minimum reviewers permits changes without required peer review.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Check threshold and any mandatory approvers; duplicated default branch controls.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Allowing change authors to approve their own PRs removes independent review.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Production/default protected branches get priority; not a direct critical exploit.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Votes persisting after code changes can allow approval of a different revision.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: High only if independent reapproval is otherwise absent on sensitive branches.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Missing work-item links reduces audit trail, not directly deployment security.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Optional for projects without linked work-item workflow.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Unresolved PR comments can hide review concerns but do not necessarily bypass approvals.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Review relevance depends on code review process.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Lack of a mandated merge strategy is a consistency preference, not significant security exposure.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Choose strategy to suit the workflow.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. A missing build-validation gate increases defect risk; any build gate may be a no-op.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Focus on meaningful test/security validation rather than mere policy presence.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. No default-branch policy may permit changes to bypass review.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Overlap with DefaultBranchPolicyIsEnabled and member/CI rules.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Disabled default-branch policies may permit unreviewed merges.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Overlap with HasDefaultBranchPolicy and general branch policy checks.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Lack of mandatory default-branch reviewers weakens change control.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Escalate only for production-sensitive repos and weak compensating checks.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Allowing self-approval of default branch changes weakens review independence.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Consider branch criticality and whether other reviewers are still mandatory.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Keeping approvals after PR revisions may leave unreviewed changes accepted.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Conditional on change content and other review requirements.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Missing README reduces project discoverability.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Engineering hygiene only.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Missing LICENSE limits legal reuse clarity; not a security vulnerability.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: More relevant to public/open-source repositories; may be N/A.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. No linked work item reduces change traceability.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: May not apply where another approval/ticketing system is used.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. PR threads left unresolved may conceal issues but is not a direct exploit.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Treat as review effectiveness indicator.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Merge strategy restrictions are mainly process consistency.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: No universal secure merge strategy.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Disabling a specific licensed scanning product is not synonymous with missing effective scans.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Check alternative scanning and entitlement; potentially N/A.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Not using licensed push protection is a missing control, not proof of existing leaked secrets.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Accept equivalent pre-receive/CI secret scanning and license applicability.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Repository permission inheritance is safe when the project ACL grants suitable rights.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Inspect effective write/admin privileges before raising risk.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. No build validation can allow untested code; rule cannot attest to test quality.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Do not double-count with other branch-policy missing checks.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Project-wide repository rights might be appropriate for a development team.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Escalate if everyone can write/administer sensitive repos.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Short artifact retention may hinder incident investigation or audit evidence.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Policy-dependent; default seven days is not inherently severe.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Short PR run retention may limit forensic and audit traceability.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Apply organization-specific retention obligations.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Production connection without checks may be used for unauthorized deployments.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Verify other independent controls and resource-level permissions.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. No human review increases change-authorization risk for production connections.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Automated policy-driven change approval can be a compensating control.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Missing service-connection description reduces ownership clarity.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: No direct security vulnerability.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Production service connection scoped too broadly expands lateral movement and blast radius.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Confirm resource scopes, Azure RBAC and production privilege.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Federation reduces stored-secret risk but non-federated identities may be securely managed.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Check connection type, managed identity options and expiring credentials.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Production connection usable from any branch broadens deployment execution paths.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Relevant only to sensitive production service connections.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Classic Azure service connections can imply subscription-wide legacy authorization scope.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Critical only when highly privileged credentials and exposure are demonstrated.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Personal GitHub PAT connection ties access to a human and may increase token lifecycle risk.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Higher if token is over-scoped or stored/exposed insecurely.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Inherited service connection ACL may be safe or unsafe depending on effective Use rights.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: High for unrestricted production connection use; not for inheritance alone.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Permitting all valid project users to use a connection may expose a privileged cloud identity.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Inspect whether Use/Manage rights and cloud-side scope are genuinely broad.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Storing Azure DevOps secret variables without Key Vault is not automatically plaintext exposure.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Evaluate encryption, secret scope, controls and secret rotation.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Variable-group description improves maintainability and ownership clarity.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Not a direct security exposure.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Actual plaintext secrets in variable groups can leak through variable access or runs.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Validate the check differentiates unprotected values from encrypted secret variables.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Inherited variable-group permissions are not independently unsafe.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Check secret-use access and effective permissions.

Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Granting all project users explicit variable-group permissions may enable unauthorized secret usage.
Rules.ApplicabilityGuidance: Assess read/manage/use rights and actual secret content.
